commits.summary: Bind independent Guava proofs to change-plan obligations
commits.body:
Expose the full application-method theorems for Guava examples 336 and 346 and the eight independently checked CNF queries of 336’s bounded first-match task. Each entry binds the original artifact bytes, claim, evidence, checker and surviving assumptions. The historical experiment had already landed on this branch.

Recounted all 111 frozen cases, checked the ten exported nodes against their evidence and ran the changed-test selection. All 59 Rust test binaries passed.

commits.summary: Freeze three Petclinic workflows before evaluating the Boot migration
commits.body: Select the last pre-migration application and the upstream stable Boot 3.0.0 adaptation from POM history. Register the intended deployments, independent owner-form inputs, observable persistence and validation results, permitted differences, resource budgets and counting rules before inspecting the application or its tests. The registration parses as JSON and the changed-test selection passed.

commits.summary: Run change plans on bound JVM deployments (verification pending)
commits.body:
Inventory public and framework entries on both deployments. Bind runtime and test classpaths independently, including resources, class selections, Java images, assumptions, tool and observer identities. Compose original-entry observations by checked domain coverage, carry explicit allowed changes, reuse qualified positive sides on exact bindings and replay divergent calls. The target runner exposes the same source claims and independent routes for numbered examples.

The current workflow and the new public factory observers reproduced both Wire reads and both outgoing linkage errors. An 8-to-17 deployment control gave the same outcomes. Five unit controls cover missing and duplicate partitions, exception binding, allowed differences, receiver discovery and corrupt or inapplicable cache entries. The changed test selection passed all 55 groups. The held-back Petclinic registration fixes three HTTP workflows and preserves separate binary, source and adapted application questions.

Queue 20261124-015038-compare-six-wire-change-plans-against-in for clean equivalence under dependency and resource edits, 20261124-015127-evaluate-the-registered-petclinic-2-7-to for the held-back migration, 20261124-020146-retry-java-semantics-callers-before-rece for the 15 semantic families followed by physical receiver controls, and 20261124-014943-replay-the-guava-change-plan-nodes-and-i for independent kernel and producer-fault replay.
